messages:
Emma H: Heads up — trying to bump GPU quota in asia-southeast1 for the new Dedicated pool, but GCP put the account on payment hold.
Sanjay: Any error details / screenshot?
Emma H: GCP console shows: 'Business verification required - payments on hold'. Card declines and there's an unresolved invoice (INV-20250301). Also a note about missing VAT/tax cert for the APAC billing profile.
Raj: That'll block any quota approvals. GCP won't process quota changes on suspended accounts.
Carol: This blocks the pilot rollout tomorrow morning. Can finance do a wire or fix the card quickly?
finance-ops: We tried re-submitting the tax form last week but the address on the verification doc didn't match Google's business registry. Payments team is trying to get an expedited review, but they need a scanned company certificate + proof of address from legal.
Emma H: We need GPUs in that region to validate latency for SEA customers. Any fast mitigations?
Sanjay: Short term: fallback to us-west1 where we already have quota. Long term we need the asia account cleared.
Sanjay: Quick checks: run `gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-prod --format='json(quotas)'` to confirm allocations.
Raj: Another option: partner account (partner-x) has spare A100 capacity, but cross-account routing requires VPC peering + IAM setup. That's a 2-3 hour lift.
Carol: For the pilot, fallback to us-west1 is acceptable if we can keep perf notes. Emma, can you spin up a temporary pool there?
Emma H: I'll provision a small pool in us-west1 and run the smoke. Starting in ~5m.
billing-bot: Case created: GCP Support 123456789 — 'Business verification / payments hold'. Priority: P1 (customer-facing).
finance-ops: Update — sent scanned company registration + utility bill to GCP compliance contact. Also initiated a manual wire for the outstanding invoice. ETA on review: 2-4 hours but pushing for 60-90m.
Sanjay: K, I'm kicking off `./scripts/provision-gpu --region us-west1 --pool test-pilot --count 4` now. Will paste job id when created.
Emma H: Job id: job-8842. Smoke tests started. If anything fails I'll post logs here.
Carol: Thanks. Plan recap: 1) fallback us-west1 pool up now; 2) finance to escalate verification and wire; 3) if GCP clears within window, migrate traffic to asia-southeast1; 4) otherwise continue on fallback and update customers. @finance-ops @Sanjay :thumbsup:
finance-ops: Roger — will update this thread with GCP confirmation and any invoices/wire receipts.
Emma H: Thanks all. Will keep this thread updated with provisioning logs and perf numbers. :pray:
